spans.s:
dvá [482b], num. two. [cf. δύο, Lat. duo,
Eng. two.]

dvaṃdvá, n. pair; quarrel. [dvaṃ-dvam
is the repeated nom. s. n. of dva: cf.
1252^2.]

dvayá, a. twofold; of two sorts; as n.
couple, pair. [dvá: cf. δοιός, ‘double.’]

dvā́daśa [483^4], cardinal. twelve. [dvá
+ dáśa, 476^3: cf. δυώδεκα, Lat. duōdecim,
‘twelve.’]

dvādaśá, f. -ī́, ordinal. twelfth; dvādaśī́
(sc. tithi), twelfth day of a lunar
half month, 59^9. [dvā́daśa, 487^7.]

dvādaśa-rātra, n. space of twelve
nights. [dvā́daśa + rātri, 1315b, 13123, 4.]

dvādaśasāhasra, a. consisting of twelve
thousand. [dvādaśa-sahasra, 1204c.]

dvā́r [388c], f. door. [perhaps ‘the closure,
’ fr. √dvṛ, ‘close,’ for *dhvṛ: cf. θύρα,
‘door’; Lat. foris, nom. s., ‘door’; Eng.
door.]
dvāra-pakṣa, m. side of the door.
